items.en: Sem can search and reference your earlier conversations, and link to the one it drew on.
items.zh: Sem 可以搜索并引用以前的对话，回答里会附上来源对话的链接。

items.en: Ask Sem to compact the conversation.
items.zh: 可以直接让 Sem 压缩对话。

items.en: Confirming it's you for sensitive account actions now appears up front in place of the form, so the dialog no longer changes size.
items.zh: 敏感账户操作的身份确认改为一打开就显示在表单的位置，对话框不再变高。

items.en: Connect an MCP client or create an API token from one "New connection" button, with each client's icon in the token list.
items.zh: 连接 MCP 客户端与创建 API 令牌合并为一个「新建连接」入口，令牌列表显示各客户端的图标。

items.en: Add buttons above lists and tables now use the accent color, so they are easier to find.
items.zh: 列表和表格上方的添加按钮改用强调色，更容易找到。
